commands.command:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-api.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory API service
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/inventory-api/app.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=1
OOMScoreAdjust=-1000
User=root

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now inventory-api
sleep 1
systemctl is-active inventory-api
curl -s http://$NODE_IP:8080/health
